start.dialog: Aetherreach has its own martial tradition—the Wind Riders, aerial combatants who fight from drake-back. They're recruiting, and the trials are open to outsiders. Pass, and you earn their respect, their techniques, maybe even a drake of your own. Fail, and you fall. Interested in testing your sky-combat skills?
start.objective: Register for and begin the Wind Rider trials

progress.dialog: Initial trials passed—basic flight maneuvers, combat formations, aerial tactics. Now the real test: the Gauntlet Run. Navigate the obstacle course, defeat the trial opponents, reach the finish with your flag intact. Only one in ten pass. Show them why you're different.
progress.objective: Complete the Gauntlet Run and earn Wind Rider status

complete.dialog: Gauntlet conquered, flag intact, Wind Rider status earned. They haven't seen a performance like yours in decades. The Wind Riders welcome you as one of their own—different style, same spirit. Ride the winds, Kade. You've earned your place in the sky.

party_comments.kade: That gauntlet was intense! Flying through rings while fighting opponents? Best combat training I've ever had.
party_comments.ashka: You have natural aptitude for aerial combat. The Wind Riders recognized it. I'm proud to fly with you, Kade.
party_comments.korr: Aerial tactics are crucial for modern warfare. These techniques complement my ground command experience. Valuable training.
